title: Bowl Cooking
description: Add foods recipe using bowl. Few pie and juice recipes also added.
body:
# **Notes**
**This pack requied Resourcepack**(Resourcepack can be downloaded together with Datapack)
# Discription
This Datapack mainly adds food and cooking recipe. more recipes will be added in future updates. Currently there are the following recipe. Details of each recipe and food added can be found in the gallery.

- 6 recipe using bowl
  - Recipes unlock when you get a bowl in inventory.
- 2 pie recipe 
  - Recipes unlock when you get suger and an egg in inventory.
- 2 juice recipe using glass bottle 
  - Recipes unlock when you get glass bottle in inventory.
  - Juices can be consumed even at full hunger point to restore saturation hanger point.

Adjustment of vanilla food recipes
- Reduced the number of beetroot required for beetroot soup to 3.

This Pack supports English and Japanese.

# How to download
Click a version you want to download.

![Click a version you want to download.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/329106fca7b9503f5c59c45a608ab079bacbed29_0.webp)

You can find datapack and resource pack.

![You can find datapack and resource pack.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7566b71a4fa62aa1a609847bf4448d2ceb0c7c81_0.webp)

# Others
- This pack is under development. I'm working to adds more recipes, these recipes will add recipes will be implemented in updates over the coming months.
